whenToUse: Short staging in videos, ads, or a first screen.
whenNotToUse: It keeps repeating and disrupts other content.
There's no way to stop it.

alternatives.name: Rotating Words
alternatives.reason: Swapping one word at a time.

accessibility: Motion plays only under motion-safe, so it stops with reduced motion.
Even when letters are split one by one, screen readers get the whole phrase through aria-label.
Use continuously repeating motion only for short staging.
A toggle to compare with plain text shows the difference the effect makes.
